info.title: hermes-studiotwin dashboard API v1 (frozen, S03)
info.description: DESIGN §5 routes mounted by pinned core under /api/plugins/hermes-studiotwin. Every route is nonbilling: the backend never authorizes, consents or dispatches.

get.description: S15 maps opaque, scope/generation-bound local cursors to upstream offset pagination. Fetch limit+1 (or a bounded lookahead) to establish hasMore; never infer a total. Cursors expire on scope generation change; foreign/expired cursors return not-found. Concurrent upstream changes may shift pages; deduplicate by Concept ID without inventing snapshot revisions.
get.x-studiotwin-origin: S03 addition: §5 lists no Concept read route; S15 owns dashboard/services/concepts.py and the gateway allowlist (§7.3) includes Concept get/status.

get.description: History is a bounded local window over mediated upstream asset/operation history. It preserves pending/failed attempts with null assetId. Missing timestamps sort first, then createdAt ascending, preserving upstream order on ties. S15 checks active markers against activeAssetId, sourceConceptId ownership/visibility, and generation-bound history cursors. An absent revision is null, never a fabricated zero. No arbitrary server metadata is forwarded.

MediatedTextV1.description: Text that has passed the S06/S07 result-mediation boundary (D20). Never carries a URL, storage URI, presigned field, query string or credential.

LocalPathV1.description: Absolute POSIX path; the backend sandbox (§5) still resolves, allow-lists and fstat-checks it.

IncompatibleContractV1.description: 412 refusal: the request named another contract version. Never a best-effort guess.

StatusV1.description: Never carries the key or any credential value.

createdAtRaw.description: Optional safe raw timestamp fallback. S12 preserves only mediated display text; absent means unavailable, not zero epoch.

contentRoute.description: The only renderer-visible media location (§5 secret boundary).

AssetPageV1.description: offset/limit are local windowing over the full scoped list; the server tool has no cursor.

submittedAtRaw.description: Optional mediated raw timestamp fallback for S14; never forward raw diagnostics.

UploadCreatedV1.description: Plugin-local opaque upload ID. StudioTwin presigned fields never leave backend memory (D09).

LineageV1.description: Bounded DAG: at most 100 nodes, depth 12.

BlenderPlanV1.description: Preflight only. Execution is a separate consented action outside this contract.

inputs.description: Candidate effective inputs; the gateway canonicalizes and classifies them.

maxCredits.description: Maximum enforced by the authenticated server's verified conditional submission contract, not the local estimate. Never present in interim-local.

observedAtMs.description: Timestamp of the price observation, not browser receipt. Omitted/null means freshness unknown; never show a fresh estimate.

QuotePreviewV1.description: A classified local preview. Never authorizes or dispatches; consent only via the MCP elicitation round trip (§5.3). estimatedCredits remains an estimate in both modes. maxCredits is a distinct server-mode bound, required only in server-max-credits and forbidden in interim-local. S10 must verify authenticated paidSubmissionMaxCreditsV1 proof before emitting server mode; labels are not capability proof. Interim execution additionally requires Victor's risk acceptance and D24/D31. observedAtMs (when supplied) is the estimate observation time, not a guaranteed price; S10/S23 must check observation <= expiry and freshness before displaying a fresh estimate.

ConceptHistoryEntryV1.description: Safe timeline metadata only. Upload operations normalize to attach. Unknown kind/state stays unknown. A null assetId is legitimate for pending and retained unsuccessful operations; never invent an asset. Raw times are bounded mediated text, never raw diagnostics. S15 checks chronological and active-asset relations at runtime.

revision.description: Only a server-supplied revision; null when not supplied. Never infer a revision from timestamps or list order.

sourceConceptId.description: Verified visible same-scope fork origin, or null if unavailable. Not proof that the source still exists.
